title: PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement
abstract: arXiv:2609.05676v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation.   We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. translated_title: PAC-隐私保护自回归生成：将噪声校准至集成分歧程度
translated_abstract: 在私有文本上微调的语言模型通常通过API提供服务，因此隐私泄露是通过生成的输出而非暴露的模型权重发生的。私有预测（Private prediction）正是为了保护这类发布。诸如PMixED之类的方法在每次发布时都会产生隐私成本，且在长序列生成中越来越依赖公共模型。PAC隐私（PAC privacy）则根据可能秘密之间的输出变异性来校准噪声，当预测稳定时添加更少的噪声。据我们所知，PAC隐私保护预测此前尚未从分类任务扩展到自回归生成任务。我们从私有语料库中构建了m=128个相互重叠的“世界”，每条记录恰好出现在m/2个世界中，并在冻结的公共模型之上为每个世界训练一个适配器。实际实现的世界即为秘密。在生成每个词元时，公共模型定义一个候选集合，各世界进行投票，其后验加权分歧程度决定PAC噪声的大小；当所有世界完全一致时则无需（文本在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文将PAC隐私保护预测从分类任务首次扩展到自回归生成，通过在128个重叠世界（各自训练适配器）上投票，并根据各世界后验加权的分歧程度动态校准噪声，在预测一致时减少噪声，从而在保护隐私的同时提升生成质量。
en_tdlr: This paper extends PAC-private prediction from classification to autoregressive generation by training 128 adapters on overlapping worlds and calibrating noise to their posterior-weighted disagreement at each token, adding less noise when predictions are stable to balance privacy protection and generation quality.
